lines.text: Many learners say: Three thousands people came.
After a number, thousand stays the same.
Thousand! There are five thousand books here.

data.why: After a number, thousand stays the same.

native.hook: 数字后面 thousand 不加 s！
native.tip: 中文说“三千”，“千”不会变。英语也一样，数字后面的 thousand 不加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Three thousands people came.”😅 数字后面的 thousand 不加 s，three thousand 才对：“Three thousand people came.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Three thousand people came.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}
